[TODO:pt-BR] Flee with what little remains

angel_call.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "The Lord is with you, mighty one."
The words shake your trembling heart.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Laugh and dismiss the angel
[TODO:pt-BR] Insist you are too weak
[TODO:pt-BR] Bow and accept His calling

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Bow and accept His calling

weak_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He chose you because you are small.
Let Him be strong through you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Bow and accept His calling

fleece_test.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Doubt still gnaws at your heart.
You lay the wool on the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Ask humbly for His confirmation

[TODO:pt-BR] He grants signs to the humble.

ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He answers honest questions.
Lay your fear before Him.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Ask humbly for His confirmation
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] His sign comes with the morning.

army_reduction.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Spring of Harod
army_reduction.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Your army is too many," He says.
Thirty-two thousand wait behind you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Refuse — you need every man
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] His count is not your count.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Send home the fearful and watchful
[TODO:pt-BR] Hide some in the hills as backup

refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] If you keep the many, you steal His glory.
Obey and trim the ranks.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Send home the fearful and watchful
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The camp grows still and small.

hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Trust the few He has chosen.
Hidden men reveal hidden fear.

night_attack.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Three Hundred at Midnight
night_attack.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The Midianite camp sprawls below.
Torches in jars, trumpets in hand.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Charge the camp in silent steel
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] His way is not the sword first.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Wait for daylight and reinforcements
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Now is the hour He gave.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Break the jars and sound the trumpets
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Light and sound flood the valley.

charge_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] His Plan, His Victory
charge_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Steel alone will not break them.
Obey the strange command.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Break the jars and sound the trumpets
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You raise the clay jar high.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Hour Is Now
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He has shaken them in their dreams.
Do not waste the night He gave.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Break the jars and sound the trumpets

victory.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Sword of the Lord
victory.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Midian turns sword on Midian.
The vast camp scatters into the dark.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Give the glory to the Lord alone
[TODO:pt-BR] Boast of your clever battle plan
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] His arm broke them, not yours.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Demand a crown from the people
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The Lord shall rule over you.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Lift His Name
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Three hundred could never have done this.
Give Him every word of praise.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Give the glory to the Lord alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You bow as the camp burns.

crown_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] He Is the King
crown_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] No throne belongs in your hand.
Return the glory to its Owner.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Give the glory to the Lord alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You lay the crown back down.

ending_faithful.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Land Has Peace
ending_faithful.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Forty years of quiet will follow.
Fear became faith, weakness His power.
